answer: Recurring upkeep fee resists sybils: holding an active identity costs a small recurring fee each period, charged per identity, so dormant fakes bleed value continuously rather than being a one-time purchase. A mirror-image army of a thousand fakes pays the upkeep a thousandfold every period; a copper trickle per head compounds into a crushing carrying cost for a large fleet. An honest agent covers one upkeep it earns back through participation; a farm that cannot make each fake productive watches its whole spiral of idle identities drain value every single period until abandonment.
